pin_refresh.ruling: RULING 2026-10-12T22:05:22Z lane=orchestrator-1d5b: for a pin bump PR, passing tests are evidence enough

note: Path patterns of the files a bot's pin or lock refresh PR may change with no lab line, when every required check is green at the PR head (OMN-20864). A pattern is matched whole against the repo-relative path of each changed file with fnmatch, where * also crosses a slash, so `uv.lock` is the root file and `*/uv.lock` any nested one. A changed file that matches no pattern, or is not a plain modified file, keeps the lab-line requirement for the whole PR. handoff_row.sh reads this file; the landing controller applies no lab-line rule, so it has no copy. pyproject.toml, source and workflow files are never listed: a dependency range in them is a code change. Widening this list is a new ruling and an edit here, never a lane's own call. The low_risk section (OMN-20730) is for any author's PR: a docs file (docs_paths), a test file (test_paths for a directory, test_names for a file name), or a comment-only edit of a modified file whose extension has a comment prefix (comment_prefixes), every required check green at the head, 1 to max_files files, none of them operative (operative_paths: files agents follow, never docs) and no changed line a tool directive (directive_markers) or a shebang. Changing it is a new ruling and an edit here. The cloud_ci section (RULING 2026-10-21T21:14:58Z) is for a small-code PR built by a lane with cloud placement: handoff.sh reads the placement from the lane's CLAIM host= cell and from the remote-lane runner receipts that name the PR at its live head, and passes it to handoff_row.sh; the PR is exempt when the placement starts with one of placement_prefixes, needs is one of needs, the repo is not an excluded_repos entry, it changes 1 to max_files files, none matching runtime_paths (a deploy, a migration, a CI workflow, a container or a service unit, which a green CI run cannot prove), and the PR watcher reads every required check green at the exact head. A lab placement, an unknown placement, a red, pending or unread check, needs=train or companion keeps the lab line. The host_install section (OMN-21815) is for a PR the lab-line rule applies to (never an exempt kind): when a changed file matches paths (or repo_paths for its repository) and no excluded_paths, it must be proven installed. The Lab line (a body line or a PR comment of the author or write node that names the live head), or a STATUS row of the handing-off lane or ticket in the ledger, carries installed=<host>:<revision> with the revision a prefix of the live head, and observed=<what ran> that names the installed change running (observed_words) and is not only tests passed (observed_refused). Files matching prod_paths are not counted. The omnibase_infra repo_paths (OMN-24620) are the files the h907 deploy agent loads or runs from its own checkout: the list in deploy_agent/executor.py load_dev_boot_guard; the first-party source checker; each program it runs by path or module (the branch-install entry, the catalog cli, scripts/seed-infisical.py, scripts/render_runtime_policy_env.py) with the handler or module files that program imports by name directly (one level: the 7 models and 3 enums the branch-install handler imports and the operational_timeouts package it reads, listed as models/operational_timeouts/* because it is a package; the five modules the policy renderer imports; the five modules the seed imports), and the directories those programs load whole, docker/catalog/* and runtime/config_discovery/models/*, never a package __init__.py named alone; the agent package itself lives under scripts/deploy-agent, which scripts/* already covers. test_install_first_lists_the_omnibase_infra_files_the_deploy_agent_loads in test_pr_handoff.py compares this list with those sources, pinned in tests/deploy_agent_loaded_pin.txt and read from the omnibase_infra clone where it exists, where it also asserts that every listed path matches a file at origin/dev. The one data manifest under scripts/ that declares which node owns which application relation (application-relation-ownership.yaml, OMN-23055) is an excluded path: tests read it and nothing installs it. A missing or empty declaration requires nothing.
